    level = [0]*next_node

                    dq.append(to)

        if v == T:
            return f
        for i in range(it_ptr[v], len(graph[v])):

                    return ret

        while True:
            f = dfs(S, INF)
            if f == 0:

            flow += f
    print(flow)
